description: Browse the packaging you can design on Creadal: boxes, pouches, bottle and jar labels, cans, cups, bags, sacks, pillow packs, mugs, t-shirts, tote bags, keychains and sneakers. Each model comes with its sizes, a photo-real preview picture and its page. Use it to pick the model for create_packaging_design or to show someone what is possible. Free, no account needed.

category.description: Optional category: boxes, labels, cans, jars, cups, pouches, bags, pillow-packs, mugs, t-shirts, tote-bags, keychains, sneakers.

language.description: Language of the names and label texts: en (default), tr or ar.

query.description: Optional words to narrow the list, e.g. 'coffee pouch', 'tuck end box', 'jar'.

name: list_packaging_models
title: Find a packaging model
